# Component inventory

Every component below already exists. **Check here before writing a new one.**
All are imported from `@martinzachariassen/design`.
Compound parts (`CardHeader`, `DialogTrigger`, …) are exported alongside their
root and omitted here; import what you need from the same package.

## brand

Identity and personality. Not generic UI — reach for these when a page needs to feel like MLZ.

- **BrandMark** — The MLZ **mark** — the Block M on a tight ink tile, the icon half of the identity (favicon, avatar, app icon, stamp).
- **FloatingMarks** — The MLZ drifting "sketch marks": small CSS-drawn engineering glyphs (square, filled square, plus, line, angle) that float slowly up-screen, fading in and out.
- **GlitchText** — The MLZ cyberpunk text effect: text is split per character and random chars flicker with an RGB-split (using the `--glitch-1` / `--glitch-2` tokens).
- **GridBackground** — The MLZ "engineering notebook" grid: a two-scale ruled background (a fine minor grid plus a 5× major grid) drawn purely from layered gradients — no image.
- **MarginNote** — One stroke of the same pen: the hand-written note in the margin is where the system stops explaining and starts talking.
- **ProjectCard** — A portfolio project card — the mlz signature applied to work: a hairline surface that lifts on hover with an offset accent shadow, a cover band, a grotesk ti…
- **RepoBanner** — A repository README banner — the wide, short header image that tops every MLZ project's `README.md`.
- **SocialCard** — A ready-to-screenshot social / Open-Graph card at the canonical 1200×630, built entirely from tokens so every app renders shares in the same voice.
- **ThemeToggle** — The light / dark / system switch, wired to `ThemeProvider` — so an app gets the system's headline feature without rebuilding the control.

## data-display

Read-only presentation of values, text and tabular data.

- **Avatar** — Identity, the mlz way: initials first.
- **Badge** — A small mono chip for status, versions and categories — the tracked-out uppercase label that sits next to a title.
- **Code** — Inline code — an identifier, a filename, a value, in running text.
- **DataList** — A definition list for key/value facts.
- **Kbd** — An inline keyboard key — a mono, hairline-bordered chip that sits in running text: press <Kbd>⌘</Kbd><Kbd>K</Kbd> to search.
- **Link** — A real anchor — navigation, with the system focus ring.
- **Prose** — Long-form typography — the "blog with a lot of text" surface.
- **Readout** — A band of headline readings across the top of a page — the five or six facts you want answered before anyone scrolls.
- **Stat** — A single headline number with its label — the unit a metrics row is built from.
- **StatusChip** — A dot-led pill for one live finding, written the way you'd say it: sentence case, in the reading face, on a tinted wash.
- **StatusDot** — A small status dot — a filled circle that carries a semantic colour and, when `pulse` is set, a soft breathing ring in the same colour (via `animate-ping` on…
- **Table** — A real `<table>` in the mlz voice: mono column headers in the eyebrow style, hairline row rules, and a row tint on hover.
- **Text** — Inline/text typography primitive — the small, everyday type roles that don't warrant a full `Prose` block: mono values, muted asides, and the tracked-out mon…

## feedback

State of the system: loading, empty, success, failure.

- **Alert** — A signal panel: a subtle-tinted fill, a left accent rail and a colour-matched title.
- **Callout** — A compact, dot-led inline note — lighter than `Alert`.
- **EmptyState** — What a list, table or panel shows when it has nothing in it.
- **FindingList** — A run of checks that have been made and their results — the output of a scan, an audit, a lint pass.
- **Progress** — A determinate progress bar: a muted track with a fill that eases to its new width over 500ms.
- **Skeleton**
- **Spinner** — An indeterminate loading ring — a bordered circle with a transparent top segment, spun with `animate-spin`.

## forms

Anything the user types, picks or toggles. Controls share the sm/default/lg/icon size scale.

- **Button** — The signature MLZ button: a technical ghost outline that lifts up and to the left on hover, dropping an offset accent shadow behind it.
- **Calendar** — A month grid for picking dates — `react-day-picker` re-dressed in the engineering-notebook voice, styled purely from semantic tokens so it follows both theme…
- **Checkbox** — A checkbox with a real `<input type="checkbox">` underneath — the box you see is a `peer`-styled label, so keyboard focus, form submission and validation are…
- **Combobox** — A `Select` you can type into — one value from a list long enough that scrolling it is a hunt.
- **CopyButton** — A `Button` that puts a string on the clipboard and says so — the label swaps to a check plus "Copied" and returns on its own.
- **DatePicker** — A date in a form field: a `Select`-shaped trigger that opens a `Calendar` in a `Popover`.
- **Field** — A labelled form control with its description and error message, wired together.
- **Input** — A single-line text field.
- **Label** — A field label in the mlz eyebrow voice — mono, uppercase, wide-tracked.
- **RadioGroup** — A set of mutually exclusive choices, all visible at once.
- **Select** — A field for choosing **one value from many** — the form control, not a menu of actions.
- **Slider** — A value picked by dragging along a track — volume, opacity, a price ceiling.
- **Switch** — An on/off toggle for settings that apply immediately — no Save button.
- **Textarea** — A multi-line text field — `Input`'s longer sibling, sharing its border, focus ring and mono type.
- **Toggle** — A button that stays pressed — bold in an editor toolbar, "show archived" on a list.
- **ToggleGroup** — A row of toggles that belong together — a view switcher, a text-alignment picker, a filter bar.

## layout

Structure and navigation. Layout primitives use the sm/md/lg breakpoint scale — do not mix with the control scale.

- **Accordion** — An accordion on the Radix primitive.
- **Breadcrumb**
- **Card** — Paper-look surfaces: elevation is a hairline border, never a heavy drop shadow.
- **Collapsible** — One thing that opens and closes.
- **NavigationMenu** — Top-level app navigation on the Radix primitive: a horizontal bar of links and hover/focus-opened panels, with the full keyboard pattern (arrows between trig…
- **Pagination** — Page-by-page navigation for a long list — a blog index, search results.
- **ScrollArea** — A scrolling box with a scrollbar that matches the system instead of the OS.
- **SectionHeading** — A section label in the tracked-out mono voice, with a hairline that runs from the end of the words to the edge of the column.
- **Separator** — A hairline rule on the Radix primitive.

## overlay

Anything that paints above the page. All Radix-backed.

- **AlertDialog** — A confirmation before something irreversible — deleting a project, revoking a key, discarding unsaved work.
- **Command** — A filterable list of commands — the ⌘K palette, and the engine behind `Combobox`.
- **Dialog** — A modal dialog built on the native `<dialog>` element — so focus-trapping, the Esc key, background inerting and the top layer come from the platform, with no…
- **DropdownMenu** — A menu of **actions** hanging off a button — row actions, an overflow "…" menu, an account menu.
- **HoverCard** — A rich preview that appears on hover — a user card behind an @mention, a repository summary behind a link.
- **InfoTip** — An inline "info tip": a small icon button that sits in the flow of text and, on click, opens a little popover explaining a term.
- **Popover** — A non-modal panel anchored to the thing that opened it — a filter menu, a colour picker, a small form that would be too much for a tooltip and too little for…
- **Sheet** — A panel that slides in from an edge — mobile navigation, a filter drawer, a detail pane beside a list.
- **Tooltip** — A small label that appears on hover or keyboard focus — the name of an icon button, or a truncated value in full.
